title: Kernel comparison for the dual of a finite free constant matrix
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. For nonnegative integers $n,m$, let $g:\Lambda^m\to\Lambda^n$ be a linear map. Let $C$ be the constant coefficient sheaf functor on the small étale site of $X$ [def-constructible-constant], and let $D(F)=\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(F,\Lambda_X)$, where $\Lambda_X$ is the tensor unit. Write $g^\vee:(\Lambda^n)^\vee\to(\Lambda^m)^\vee$ for precomposition with $g$. Then $\ker(D(C(g)))\cong C(\ker(g^\vee))$ as sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules.

proof.text: Identify each finite free module with the biproduct of n or m copies of the coefficient ring. Constant sheafification preserves finite biproducts and its monoidal unit constraint identifies the constant coefficient ring with the sheaf tensor unit. The tensor-Hom adjunction identifies the dual of each finite biproduct of units with that same biproduct. Composing with the dual basis isomorphism gives the constant sheaf of the module dual. The rank-zero case is the zero object.

For a matrix g, these dual-basis identifications form a commuting square: evaluation of precomposition at the j-th basis vector is the sum, over i, of the coefficient of e_i in g(e_j) times the i-th dual coordinate. This is exactly the formula for the constant sheafification of g.dualMap. The calculation is linear and valid over any commutative ring.

Transport the categorical kernel along this commuting square. Constant sheafification preserves finite limits (it is the constant presheaf functor followed by left exact sheafification), hence preserves kernels. Finally use ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer to identify the categorical module kernel with the linear kernel submodule. Compose the resulting isomorphisms. Neither noetherianity nor a presentation of an arbitrary module is needed; empty schemes and the zero ring cause no exception.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_constantFiniteMatrixDualKernelIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (n m : ℕ) (g : (Fin m → Λ) →ₗ[Λ] (Fin n → Λ)) :
    Nonempty (kernel
      ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj
        (𝟙_ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))).map
          ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
            (ModuleCat.ofHom g)).op) ≅
      (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of Λ (LinearMap.ker g.dualMap)))
